{{Quote|It's a fuel mostly been mined out on Abafar. It's volatile and dangerous.|[[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]]|<ref name="Missing in Action">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>}}
'''Rhydonium''' was a volatile type of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]], found for the most part on the remote planet [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].

==History==
[[File:RhydoniumExplosion-PoNR.png|thumb|left|220px|The explosion caused by rhydonium was immensely powerful.]]
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had a mining facility that extracted rhydonium on Abafar, in the settlement of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]]. This rhydonium was later stored aboard a [[Renown/Legends|hijacked]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|cruiser]] so as to ram the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|space station]] hosting the [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|Republic strategy conference]] in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]], thus killing scores of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Republic [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. However, the actions of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] prevented this by first speeding up the ship then activating the bombs earlier, destroying the ship and all battle droid forces but saving the conference.
